response.overview: The fastest ways to get a quick response from travelocity  are using the mobile app live chat, calling during off-peak hours, or posting on social media. Call (1)~\~855~\~590~\~0778 (US)  (US) or 44/204^586^5278 (UK)  Use the Mobile App Chat Open the travelocity  Help Center or download the mobile app to start an in-app chat. Type words like "Live Agent" or "Representative" right away at (1)~\~855~\~590~\~0778 (US)  (US) or 44/204^586^5278 (UK) to skip the automated computer menu. Wait times on the app usually take about 10 to 30 minutes.
